notes.title: vRC.02 Build - Sad Narwhal + Bug Swatting
notes.content:
Welcome to vRC.02, Heroes!

Fixed several reported UI bugs and gameplay issues related to:
- Keyboard vs Controller collisions in UI overlays
- Keyboard input overrides in Build dialogs
- Unexpected Pet Unlock ceremonies
- Misc. enemy projectile improvements

notes.content:

notes.title: CHRONODOJO NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
ITS FINALLY TIME TO PLAY HERO! 
Put on your pump kicks and connect your controllers, it's time to launch fighters!

Happy Leap Day! It's finally time to heroically jump, build towers and battle your way through the wacky worlds and exciting eras of ChronoDojo!  

We are so proud/exhilirated/bananas to finally share our cute cooperative combo of Tower Defense and Beat 'em Up.  It's been a leap year in production and now it's finally ready for release.  So, choose your favorite humble hero, it's time to Chrono-Fu your way to maximum victory!

Good luck! Have fun!

[previewyoutube=LlgYhFIyRMI;full][ YT Video ][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ChronoDojo Launches February 29th!
notes.content:
ITS ALMOST TIME TO PLAY HERO! 
Grab yourself a bev boost and crank up the Chronobox- ChronoDojo launches on February 29th!

There's no better time than this leap day (aka February 29th) to heroically jump, build towers and battle your way through the wacky worlds and thrilling times of ChronoDojo!  

The brother sister duo that is StarCouch which is us (woo hoo!) are so freakin' pumped to release our crazy couch co-op combo of Tower Defense and Beat 'em Up here on Steam!  We can't wait for you to Chrono-Fu your way through hundreds of waves of cartoon evil and battle all our big bad bosses! 

Who among you is hero enough?
[previewyoutube=L5C_FEVtpH8;full][/previewyoutube]
You've got a week to plug in your controllers, pick your favorite humble hero and prepare yourself! 
It's almost time to play hero!

notes.title: February Game Update!
notes.content:
HELLO HEROES, NEAR AND FAR 
We grow ever closer to ChronoDojo's launch! Woo-hoo! Let's spotlight a way to all sit on the same virtual couch together and play ChronoDojo: Remote Play Together!  

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER

The only thing better than saving the world from eeeevil using your Chrono-Fu skills... is teaming up and playing hero with all of your friends!  But what if you can't all get together on the same couch to enjoy the cozy co-op fun?  Thanks to Steam's Remote Play Together feature, now you can! (well, virtually at least...)

Unfamiliar with RPT?  It's easy!  Simply launch the ChronoDojo Demo, Shift-Tab (or Alt-Tab) to your friends list, and invite anyone to play!  You'll then automatically stream your game session to them, and they'll stream their inputs to you!  Boom! You're playing together remotely!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/383a5ccce53552dfe77219f607756a1ef9cd3684.jpg

Dev confession- we've been utilizing RPT to playtest and develop ChronoDojo from very very early on!  We love it and are excited for you to try it out.  Let us know how it goes!  

 
REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER FEST & LET'S PLAYS

The timing couldn't be better to spotlight RPT, because ChronoDojo will be in Steam's Remote Play Together Fest! (Feb. 12-19)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/df489154eeecd30ceded92bf683b61a041a6713a.jpg

Keep your eyes peeled, we'll be broadcasting Remote Play Together Let's Plays w/ fun foks from as far away as the UK and with friends of ours including George Fan (the braaaains behind PvZ, Octogeddon, and the recently-released HardHat Wombat)!

notes.title: January Game Update!
notes.content:
WELCOME BACK, CHRONO-FRIENDS! 
We hope you all had the awesomest of holiday seasons!  To kick off the new year, let's spotlight a wacky way to play ChronoDojo: Mini-games!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: MINI-GAMES
Do you need a quick break from saving the world from evil?  Are you feeling the urge to fight your own friends for fun?  It's time to take an intermission from your heroic mission with multiple mini-games!

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/ff0f35653448a876e72cdb725db3117922409b5a.png
[/td]
[td]
Step into the Eat No Eat carnival tent in the parking lot of the mall to face waves of edible "EATS" (yummy street & junk food) and inedible "NO EATS" (cute critters that look very similar to EATS, but bite back!).  Whoever chomps the most EATS wins!
[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/09dcc92c5176e3f9ad2312dea15e1a9bbdd6de74.png
[/td]
[td]
Board the pirate's treasure ship to plunder their cargo!  Haul huge treasures to your hero-specific chest while deftly dodging cannonballs, pesky pirates, and your own 'friends' (who can pilfer your prizes right out of your hands!) Whoever hoards the most booty wins!
[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/b2ecafc15faba3774d2fabc67cbb781a2b8384d4.png
[/td]
[td]
Venture into an active volcano to forage for delicious fungi!  Stay ahead of the swiftly-rising magma, avoid explosive boom shrooms and gather green 'shrooms as you race to the peak!  Whoever harvests the most mushrooms is the champignon champion!
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Dang!  Doesn't that all sound mega-fun?  Let's play some Mini-games!
[previewyoutube=zIsothEIi0U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: December Game Update!
notes.content:
HEY THERE, HUMBLE HEROES! 
Another marvelous month has passed as we polish, playtest and punch bugs in prep for launching ChronoDojo next year!  As this year nears an end, we'd love to spotlight some adorably fun features: 
Pets & Egg Defense! 

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: PETS & EGG DEFENSE
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/03c9f3abe24d0f20cc9d48bc248a4154bd572d3e.png
[/td]
[td]
Meet a fellow hero and time-traveler- "Tender, the Time-traveling Naturalist!"  Her monumental mission is to locate and save super-special species the moment before they go extinct!
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/a95f4d08021128d52c0b75c23102da6abf79dd3c.png
[/td]
[td]
She'll mark on your world maps (including previous worlds you've saved) with newly-located eggs.  You'll then need to bash, build and defend the Dojo all over again on those levels, but this time- you must also protect the fragile friendly egg from being fractured by the forces evil!  
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/bc255f3903dc5f09e34bec18327e551d3572e650.png
[/td]  
[td]
If you can save both the enormous egg and the Dojo, Tender will reward you by hatching it into a loyal, powerful pet that will follow you into future battles and fight along your side!  Woo hoo!  Collect all the unique pets to see which perfectly pairs with your play style!
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
But let's let Tender take the mic, after all- she's the egg explorer extraordinaire!:
[previewyoutube=FXTZ8fCeNQg;full][/previewyoutube]Save the world, if only for the pets!

notes.title: November Game Update!
notes.content:
HELLO, STUDENTS OF CHRONO-FU!
Since our announcement a month ago at NextFest, we've been bashing, bug-swatting and beautifying ChronoDojo, and are on track for a release early next year!  Let's take a quick break to spotlight a crazy cool chrono-feature and to highlight and thank you for great changes based on your fine feedback!


FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: CHRONOPOWERS
Soon after defeating Channel Omega and saving the 80's Sunset Plaza Mall, the ChronoDojo whisks our humble heroes away to the next world and time... and Sensei teaches them their unique ChronoPowers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/44ca758a2e26fcb61503ff9b00ce6c95526a4284.png
ChronoPowers are ultimate hero abilities that both spawn a powerful ChronoPower Tower (unique to each hero) and chrono-boosts your hero to turbo-bash baddies and move at manic speeds!  

But Sensei is a much better teacher.  Check out her lesson:
[previewyoutube=eyiOnZ9iPr4;full][/previewyoutube]Now that's playing with (Chrono) power!


DEMO FEEDBACK
We are pumped up by how many times our demo has been downloaded and played and hope you're all having a heck-ton of fun!  Further- we are overjoyed to receive feedback, both negative and positive, to help us improve ChronoDojo!

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/41ecb639eebb0ed59ff948680f20ca033927b1c5.png
[/td]
[td]
Helpful highlights:

 Nerfing and smoothing of early World 1 difficulty ramp
 Re-balance of early-game Gardener weapons
 Re-balance of Channel Omega boss battle (early economy and difficulty)!
 Pinata no longer damages Dojo, nor does it drop candy if Dojo defeats it!

[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

NEW BUILD!
Steam should update you to the latest build (v.010), where you can check out these changes and more.  Check it out, let us know what you think, and if you haven't yet, wish list ChronoDojo today!

notes.title: Introducing ChronoDojo!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/9df4ec85ef26d002be2461f58547bff183f65805.png

We are thoroughly thrilled to finally announce our first game, ChronoDojo!

We’ve been carefully crafting our cute, couch-cooperative blend of Beat ‘em Up (Castle Crashers, TMNT) and Tower Defense (PvZ, Bloons TD) for a few years now… and friend & family playtests have been hilarious button-mashing bonanzas!
 
It's finally time to share the fun, so along with our announcement, we’ve released a Playable Demo!

Join us in developing this dream project into its awesomest-possible final form by sharing your feedback, ideas and bugs in our Demo Feedback forum, learn more on our Store Page, and while you’re there, wishlist today!

It’s time to Bash, Build and Be Heroes!
